## Remediation Applied

All edits reconcile the spec/plan/tasks artifacts only; no feature code was changed. Each fix aligns
an artifact with a decision already settled in spec §Clarifications, so all were mechanical /
light-touch and none required a new clarification entry.

1. **C1 (MEDIUM)** — `tasks.md`: retitled the Phase 5 heading from
   "User Story 3 - Smaller, faster harness image builds" to
   "User Story 3 - Common work built and stored once, faster rebuilds", matching spec US3 and the
   re-scoped FR-011/SC-005. This was the last place the rejected "smaller footprint" framing survived
   (the Phase 5 Goal/Independent Test/Checkpoint bodies had already been updated).
2. **U1 (LOW)** — `data-model.md`: added a "`/workspace` image-time owner" invariant to the shared
   base entity, noting the directory is created **root-owned** (base runs `WORKDIR /workspace` while
   root, vs. today's `USER node` → `WORKDIR`) and that the runtime `-v {ws}:/workspace` bind mount in
   `orchestrator/factory.py` overrides the image-time owner — so the shift is a conscious no-op, not a
   parity break.
3. **G1 (LOW)** — `tasks.md`: expanded T012 to state it is the hermetic approximation of US1's
   "run one agent end to end" Independent Test (functional/format equivalence per FR-008, proven by
   unchanged wrapper/runner + report code and the unchanged parser suite), and made an operator's live
   per-harness end-to-end run an explicit **optional, non-blocking** extra check.
4. **I1 (LOW)** — `tasks.md`: added `useradd|adduser` to T015's grep pattern so its literal check
   matches quickstart §4's `apt-get|useradd|adduser|^WORKDIR|python3-pip|dagster-pipes` guard.
5. **A1 (LOW)** — `spec.md`: tightened FR-002 to name the `build-essential` apt package inline,
   removing the soft "the standard build essentials" phrasing while keeping the descriptive lead-in.

> Note: the single remaining literal "smaller" in `spec.md` is inside the verbatim **Input** user
> description (the historical record of the original request), which is intentionally not edited. All
> normative artifact text now either omits the claim or explicitly negates it.

## Constitution Alignment Issues

None. The one Principle I trade-off (uniform `build-essential`/`gh` install into every shell-based
agent vs. strict per-agent minimum) is surfaced and accepted in spec §Clarifications (2026-09-16
remediation) and plan Constitution Check §I as a MEDIUM surfaced trade-off — no isolation boundary,
network reach, credential, or mount is widened, so it is not a Principle I violation. Principle VI
(Docs Track Reality) is *improved* by this feature: it corrects the pre-existing README build-context
bug (per-image context vs. the required `images/` context) as part of FR-012. No CRITICAL constitution
conflict exists.

## Unmapped Tasks

None. T001/T002 are Setup, T019/T020 are Polish/cross-cutting (scope + full-quickstart checks); both
roles are legitimate and carry no user story by design.

## Duplication Note (intentional, not a defect)

The `dagster-pipes==1.13.21` pin appears in both `images/agent-base/Dockerfile` (new) and
`images/agent-python/Dockerfile` (standalone). This is the single intentional duplication, forced by
FR-010 keeping `agent-python` off the Node-bearing base, and is documented in plan §Complexity
Tracking with the rejected simpler alternative. Not counted as a duplication defect.
